Alerts.reason: Coliform bacterial contamination and elevated TDS (790 mg/L) detected following pipeline excavation near Historic Market Complex.
Alerts.publicMessage: Immediate Boil-Water Advisory: Water screening indicates biological anomaly at Maharaj Bada Central Plaza sector. GMC teams actively sanitizing pipeline.

Alerts.reason: Residual chlorine depleted to 0.05 mg/L (standard threshold >= 0.20 mg/L); risk of secondary contamination in terminal line.
Alerts.publicMessage: High Advisory: Precautionary boil-water recommendation during chlorinator repair and system flush at Sikandar Kampoo.

Alerts.reason: Turbidity spike to 5.80 NTU (threshold 4.00 NTU) due to sediment agitation following Tigra conduit valve realignment.
Alerts.publicMessage: Water Quality Warning: Moderate turbidity observed at Laxmi Ganj / Gol Pahariya feeder; filtration booster running at max capacity.

Alerts.reason: Elevated pH (8.90) detected near Tansen Nagar industrial crossing; potential alkaline industrial runoff ingress.
Alerts.publicMessage: Water Advisory: Tubewell screening anomaly under investigation; industrial effluent isolation active.

Alerts.reason: Nitrate concentration reaching 58.0 mg/L (permissible limit 45.0 mg/L) following heavy agricultural runoff in peri-urban sector.
Alerts.publicMessage: Nitrate Advisory: Vulnerable populations advised to use alternate bottled supply until laboratory verification completes.

Alerts.reason: Fluoride reading at 1.85 mg/L (desirable limit 1.0 mg/L, max 1.5 mg/L) observed at deep borewell source.
Alerts.publicMessage: Notice: Geological mineral variance detected; GMC defluoridation unit engaged.

Alerts.reason: Pressure drop to 0.4 bar causing high back-siphonage risk in Air Force Road feeder zone.
Alerts.publicMessage: Supply Advisory: Intermittent pressure fluctuation in Pinto Park; distribution valves throttled for pressure stabilization.

Alerts.reason: Free residual chlorine variance between 0.12 mg/L and 0.18 mg/L during peak morning draw.
Alerts.publicMessage: Advisory: Secondary booster dosing station activated at Thatipur West.

Alerts.reason: Post-pipe replacement sediment flush generated 8.4 NTU turbidity; successfully cleared after systematic blow-off.
Alerts.publicMessage: Resolved: Water clarity restored to 0.45 NTU. Padav water distribution fully normalized.

Alerts.reason: Scheduled quarterly conduit sterilization and sand filter backwash successfully completed.
Alerts.publicMessage: Informational: Routine maintenance window concluded with all parameters within optimal thresholds.

Alerts.reason: Marginal chlorine level (0.18 mg/L) detected in terminal pipeline segment near Morar Bazaar.
Alerts.publicMessage: Notice: Dosing rate boosted at Gandhi Nagar pumping station; terminal levels recovering.

Alerts.reason: Quarterly municipal audit sampling confirmed 100% compliance across all 18 tested physical/chemical parameters.
Alerts.publicMessage: Audit Passed: City Center water supply meets all BIS 10500:2012 specifications.

ResponseActions.summary: Dispatched Zonal Water Quality Rapid Response Unit to Maharaj Bada Central Plaza.
Isolated 200m commercial feeder pipeline between Sarafa Bazar and Plaza fountain.
Published emergency boil-water bulletin on citizen portal and broadcast via GMC SMS gateway.
Commenced hyper-chlorinated scour flush (5.0 ppm NaOCl) through scour hydrants #12 and #14.
Collected 6 sterile duplicate samples for certified 24-hr membrane filtration culture test.
Inspected automated dosing pump at Gudha chlorination substation; identified peristaltic tube rupture.
Replaced metering diaphragm and replenished sodium hypochlorite solution in primary tank.
Injected shock dose to re-establish 0.60 mg/L chlorine residual across downstream distribution.
Morning resample verified chlorine recovered to 0.45 mg/L; advisory downgraded to monitoring.
Checked pressure sensor telemetry at Laxmi Ganj bypass; confirmed upstream valve throttling induced backwash.
Opened terminal blow-off valve on Kampoo link for 45 minutes until clarity improved.
Turbidity measured down to 2.1 NTU; continued monitoring through evening delivery cycle.
Joint inspection with MP Pollution Control Board at Tansen Nagar industrial drain embankment.
Temporarily diverted GMC Tubewell #01 to non-potable bypass line during chemical profiling.
Acquired grab samples for heavy metals, alkalinity, and volatile organic compound screening.
Surveillance of surrounding agricultural parcel irrigation channels and fertilizer runoffs.
Distributed warning flyers to local community center advising pregnant women and infants on bottled water.
Sent split samples to Central Public Health Engineering Laboratory in Bhopal for spectrophotometric verification.
Inspected activated alumina filter bed at Kampoo Kalan community water treatment plant.
Scheduled media regeneration with dilute caustic soda and acid neutralization wash.
Detected leaking air-release valve on Air Force Road 300mm cast-iron supply conduit.
Excavation team mobilized; emergency repair clamp installed; line pressure restored to 1.8 bar.
Adjusted feed rate on gas chlorinator at Gandhi Nagar Water Works from 1.2 kg/hr to 1.5 kg/hr.
Checked Thatipur West terminal sample tap; chlorine level verified at 0.38 mg/L.
Responded to citizen reports of brown discolored water near Railway Station Overpass.
Systematic unidirectional flushing across Padav commercial grid for 2.5 hours.
Turbidity measured at 0.45 NTU, TDS 240 mg/L; line certified clean.
Executive Engineer signed off; alert closed and public notice removed.
Conducted pre-maintenance flow measurement at Jiwaji Ganj radial well pump.
Filter media backwash completed with zero silt carryover.
Routine quarterly certificate logged into GMC water compliance database.
Measured residual chlorine at 5 public standposts along Morar Bazaar.
Raised booster chlorinator dosage at Morar Cantt overhead tank.
Sampled 12 nodal points across Sachin Tendulkar Marg and Patel Nagar.
All 18 microbiological and physico-chemical indices compliant with BIS standards.
